summary: Comprehensive frontend testing of Crown Pass Driving School website. All 16 requested features tested and verified working. Home page renders all 12 sections, navigation works between all pages, calculators update dynamically, forms validate correctly, rating modal functions properly, admin login shows appropriate Firebase error message.

integration_issues.issue: Firebase Console not configured - Firestore reads fail with 'Missing or insufficient permissions', Auth fails with 'operation-not-allowed'. This is EXPECTED per the review request and the app gracefully falls back to static data.

action_items: Configure Firebase Console: Enable Email/Password authentication under Authentication → Sign-in method
Configure Firestore security rules to allow reads/writes for ratings, messages, and other collections
critical_code_review_comments: Admin login now properly displays Firebase auth errors - this was fixed from previous iterations where errors were silent
All data-testid attributes are properly implemented for testing
Fallback static data from lib/data.js works correctly when Firestore is unavailable

success_rate.backend: N/A (Firebase-only frontend app - no custom backend)

seed_data_creation: None - app uses fallback static data from lib/data.js
context_for_next_testing_agent: All frontend features verified working. Firebase Console needs configuration for full functionality. Admin auth error is now properly displayed. App URL: https://driving-school-demo-2.preview.emergentagent.com
